en.focus: I am keeping a strict boundary between published evidence and accepted product state. VillAIgence has published the exact production-gated candidate 0.1.25+1.21.1 and has deterministic literal-loopback checks for the production Chat, STT and TTS clients, while cumulative real-provider, Voice Chat, multiplayer and gameplay acceptance remains pending. In Vlezet, M7.8B remains the latest accepted recognition slice: PR #42 is waiting for a product-owner retest, while PR #44 and PR #45 are stacked Draft work for M7.9 and M7.8C.1 only.
learning: Evidence layering in VillAIgence: separating exact release publication, production-JAR startup/restart, deterministic provider-client acceptance and cumulative installed-product acceptance
Hybrid recognition in Vlezet: allowing AI to propose missing openings while keeping local geometry immutable, deterministic revalidation, explicit Apply and owner acceptance
Content Freshness as a maintenance guard: detecting repository drift and updating the public snapshot manually without allowing automation to promote lifecycle or trust state
writing: An Engineering Note on why a successful deployment is not the same as production verification
A practical chain from source tests to exact artifact, installed startup/restart, provider boundary and cumulative acceptance
Evidence-driven project-state practices for accepted, failed, pending and Draft signals
